xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #6765

plan.title: fix(scope): post-merge completion gives merge evidence to clause items only, never to hand-written acceptance items

narratives.Description: fix(scope): post-merge completion gives merge evidence to clause items only, never to hand-written acceptance items
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

When `scope:complete` (or `swarm:finalize-cohort`) completes a story after its product PR merged and the delivery is verified, the merge stamper (`stampDeclaredMergeEvidence` via `stampMergeFromCompletionProvenance`, `packages/core/src/scope/acceptance-evidence.ts`) writes `kind: merge` evidence only on the derived `clause.N` items. It looks up items by clause id only, so hand-written acceptance items (for example `ac.1`, `ac.2`) never get evidence, and the evidence gate refuses the completion.

Evidence: `swarm:finalize-cohort --no-commit --pr <product PR> --stories <brief>` on origin/master 457cec14f, for 20 OVPR briefs. Every `clause.N` item got merge evidence; every `ac.N` item was reported "no x-directive/evidence or x-directive/disposition; scope:complete refuses to auto-complete (#3240)". Example: `xbrief/active/2026-11-18-ovpr-g-codeql.xbrief.json` with `--pr 6705`: clause.1 to clause.7 stamped, ac.1 to ac.3 refused. None of these `ac.N` items has a strict axis except one `smoke` item in the G-I brief.

## Fix

1. When completion provenance proves delivery, the merge stamper gives every non-terminal acceptance item the same `kind: merge` evidence the clause items get, hand-written items included, under the same rules: skip items that already have evidence or a disposition, and skip items whose required strict axis (smoke, uat, deploy, observed_behavior) merge cannot satisfy.
2. No new evidence kind and no change to the evidence gate. An item with a strict axis is still refused until it has suitable evidence or a disposition.

## Acceptance Criteria

- With verified delivery provenance, `scope:complete` stamps `kind: merge` evidence on a non-terminal hand-written item (for example `ac.1`) with no strict axis, and the evidence gate passes.
- A hand-written item that requires a `smoke` (or uat, deploy, observed_behavior) axis gets no merge evidence, and `scope:complete` still refuses it.
- A hand-written item that already has evidence or a disposition is left unchanged.
- Without delivery provenance, no hand-written item gets merge evidence.
